summary:
Possible integer overflow issue in the BMP decoder. Will only affect 32-bit builds so not applicable. There is a
fix that doesn't apply cleanly to our build because there is another patch to apply before it. Again it's irrelevant because
the issue will only affect 32-bit builds.
